message.content: Lua code refers to source text written in the Lua language, a compact, portable, extensible scripting system designed for embedding, game development, and rapid prototyping. Developers write readable scripts, attach them to C programs, and customize applications without recompiling core systems. The ecosystem includes packages for web, databases, graphics, automation, testing, networking, and mathematical modeling. Interpreters execute files quickly, while optional compilers produce bytecode suitable for virtual machines. Syntax emphasizes simplicity: variables, conditionals, loops, tables, functions, metatables, threads, error handling, string interpolation remain easy to learn. Because libraries connect efficiently to external services, teams can create plugins, servers, consoles, and automation tools. Documentation, tutorials, communities, and forums support beginners through advanced practitioners.
